_comment: SAMPLE DATA for BIS Indian Standards catalog. Replace or expand with official BIS Manak Online datasets.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Storage Water Heaters
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies safety and construction requirements for stationary electric storage water heaters intended for heating water below boiling temperature in domestic and commercial premises.

standards.title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Covers performance requirements, energy efficiency, standing loss, and functional testing for domestic electric water heaters.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Electric Irons
standards.scopeSummary: Safety guidelines for dry and steam electric irons intended for household and similar use.

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Requirements for materials, construction, finish, mass, and performance tests for protective helmets for drivers and passengers of motorcycles and scooters.

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Requirements and methods of sampling and test for packaged drinking water filled in sealed containers of various capacities.

standards.title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Prescribes requirements for natural mineral water packaged in hermetically sealed food-grade containers.

standards.title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies acceptable criteria for structural characteristics of toys such as shape, size, contour, spacing as well as acceptable criteria for properties peculiar to certain categories of toys.

standards.title: Safety of Toys - Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies maximum permissible limits for migration of elements like antimony, arsenic, barium, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, and selenium from toy materials.

standards.title: Safety of Electric Toys
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies requirements for the safety of toys that have at least one function dependent on electricity (battery or mains operated).

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Covers requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, and Fe 600.

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Covers requirements for steel plates, sections, flats, and bars used in welded, riveted, or bolted civil and industrial structures.

standards.title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification (Part 1 Fly Ash Based)
standards.scopeSummary: Covers manufacturing, physical, and chemical requirements of fly ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement for structural applications.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Prescribes requirements for 33, 43, and 53 grade ordinary Portland cement widely used in infrastructure and concrete constructions.

standards.title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
standards.scopeSummary: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including computer hardware, laptops, printers, scanners, and POS terminals.

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Part 2 Lithium Systems
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies requirements and tests for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries for use in portable electronic appliances such as mobile phones and power banks.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1 Safety Requirements
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services with rated wattage up to 60W.

standards.title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies the composition and fineness requirements of gold alloys used for manufacture of articles or jewellery and rules for hallmarking.

standards.title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies requirements for purity, fineness grades (990, 925, 900, 800), and assay marking for silver jewelry and silver items.

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Covers requirements for PVC insulated single-core and multi-core cables with copper or aluminum conductors used for power and lighting wiring.

standards.title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Fixed-Electrical Installations - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Covers manually operated general-purpose switches for AC only, with a rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current up to 63 A.

standards.title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies requirements for domestic pressure cookers constructed from wrought aluminum alloy or stainless steel with nominal capacities up to 22 liters.
labTestParameters: Proof Pressure Hydrostatic Test (3x working pressure)

standards.title: Sports Footwear - Specification - Part 1: General Purpose
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies performance, anatomical, and durability requirements for general-purpose sports footwear including athletic shoes, running shoes, and training sneakers.

standards.title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Liter Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases - Part 1 Cylinders for LPG
standards.scopeSummary: Requirements for the design, manufacture, and testing of welded low carbon steel cylinders for storage and transport of LPG.

standards.title: Low Pressure Regulators for Use with Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Mixtures - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Covers materials, construction, performance, and safety testing for low-pressure domestic LPG regulators fitted to gas cylinders.

standards.title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
standards.scopeSummary: Requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules suitable for long-term outdoor operation.
labTestParameters: Damp Heat Test (85% RH at 85°C for 1000h)

standards.title: Safety of Power Converters for Use in Photovoltaic Power Systems - Part 2 Particular Requirements for Inverters
standards.scopeSummary: Safety guidelines for grid-tied and stand-alone power electronic inverters used in photovoltaic energy generation systems.

standards.title: Road Vehicles - Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Fuel System Components - Container
standards.scopeSummary: Specifies design, construction, and testing of fuel containers designed for storing LPG as motor fuel on automotive vehicles.

standards.title: Automotive Tyres for Two and Three-Wheeled Motor Vehicles - Specification
standards.scopeSummary: Prescribes requirements for pneumatic tyres for mopeds, motorcycles, scooters, and three-wheelers operating on public highways.

standards.title: Room Air Conditioners - Specification - Part 1: Unitary Air Conditioners
standards.scopeSummary: Prescribes construction, performance, safety, and testing methods for window and through-the-wall unitary air conditioners.

standards.title: Room Air Conditioners - Specification - Part 2: Split Air Conditioners
standards.scopeSummary: Prescribes construction, performance, safety, and testing methods for split air conditioners with indoor and outdoor units.
